segments.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome back to EquiTips.
For anyone who is new, thank you for joining us today.
segments.zh: 对于新朋友，感谢你们今天的收看。

segments.text: My name is Ava Casper, and today we'll be discussing about CPV manufacturing.
segments.zh: 我叫 Ava Casper，今天我们来聊一聊 CPV Manufacturing。

segments.text: Founded in 1915, CPV is manufactured in Kennon Square, PA.
segments.zh: CPV 成立于 1915 年，在宾夕法尼亚州 Kennett Square 生产。

segments.text: CPV has been one of the main leaders for high-pressure valves and fittings.
segments.zh: CPV 一直是高压阀门和管件领域的主要领导者之一。

segments.text: Most of their valves and fittings have been in service for over 30 years.
segments.zh: 他们的大多数阀门和管件已经使用了 30 多年。

segments.text: They are made in the USA, and what makes it so cool and unique is you can find some of their valves
segments.zh: 它们是美国制造的，最酷、最独特的是，你可以在 NASA 和美国海军

segments.text: and fittings in NASA and in the US Navy. All of their valves are cleaned, tested, and packaged
segments.zh: 找到他们的一些阀门和管件。他们所有的阀门都按照

segments.text: per CGA and ASTM standards. Now, what makes their design so unique and easy?
segments.zh: CGA 和 ASTM 标准进行清洗、测试和包装。那么，是什么让他们的设计如此独特又好用？

segments.text: Each design has been approved by an oxygen surge tester. Their design features an
segments.zh: 每一种设计都通过了氧气冲击测试。他们的设计采用了

segments.text: ergonomic handle, which makes it extremely easy to turn under high pressures. Now, talking about
segments.zh: 符合人体工学的手柄，即使在高压下也非常容易转动。说到

segments.text: high pressures, their highest working pressure for inert gas is 7,800 PSI and 6,000 PSI for oxygen.
segments.zh: 高压，他们对惰性气体的最高工作压力是 7,800 PSI，对氧气是 6,000 PSI。

segments.text: Also, their design has a direct pipe thread connection for O-ring seal and welding.
segments.zh: 此外，他们的设计采用直接管螺纹连接，可用于 O 形圈密封和焊接。

segments.text: Now, these are just a few things that make them so unique and valuable.
segments.zh: 这些只是让他们如此独特、如此有价值的几个方面。

segments.text: The sole purpose of our Equi-tip today was to get a better understanding of CPV manufacturing and
segments.zh: 我们今天这期 EquiTips 的唯一目的，是让大家更好地了解 CPV Manufacturing，以及

segments.text: what makes them safe and different. That's all I have for you today. If you have any
segments.zh: 是什么让他们安全又与众不同。今天我要讲的就这些。如果你有任何

segments.text: additional questions or comments, please see below for our email and phone number.
segments.zh: 其他问题或意见，请查看下方我们的邮箱和电话号码。

segments.text: I will see you all next month for the next Equi-tip. Bye guys!
segments.zh: 下个月下一期 EquiTips 再见。拜拜各位！
